elements.definition: The globally unique 64-bit hardware address burned into every Zigbee chip at manufacture. Immutable. The lowest-level identity of a physical device, independent of any pairing, naming, or software state.
Manufacturer model string identifying the hardware capabilities and firmware baseline of a Zigbee device.
Manufacturer name string as reported by the Zigbee device.

The human-assigned snake_case name for a Zigbee device as configured in Zigbee2MQTT. Forms the MQTT topic path and is the stable internal key for all Z2M operations. Must use snake_case — spaces break MQTT topic parsing.
The MQTT publish/subscribe path for a device's state messages. Constructed from the Z2M topic prefix and the device friendly_name.

Z2M publishes {"state":"online"} or {"state":"offline"} to this topic when a device joins or leaves the Zigbee mesh. This is the authoritative online/offline signal — more reliable than inferring from data messages.
FaceoftheCabin's internal stable identifier for a device. Prefixed with the integration source (z2m-, home-, etc.) to namespace across multiple integration adapters.

The human-readable name for a device as set by the user at install time or via the settings panel. Completely independent of z2m_friendly_name. This is what every non-technical audience sees everywhere in the platform.
The room-level (L1) location of a device within the installation site. User selects from a curated soft-enum list. Custom values auto-submit a candidate_term_submission for master vocabulary review.

Photo taken at device install time showing the physical device and its location. Used as tile background or thumbnail. Serves as visual memory aid for all audiences and installation evidence for compliance.

The aggregate location identity for an installed device. Groups the full five-level location attribute set (L1 room, L2a zone, L2b qualifier, L3 free text, derived formatted string) under one class so automations, device naming pipelines, a

The positional (L2b) descriptor within a zone. Answers "where exactly within the zone." Soft enum scoped to parent device_location_zone. Custom values trigger candidacy submission and user alert.

A free-text narrative description of the device's physical location. Intended for human readability (semantic and compliance audiences) only. Not used in automation rules, device naming, or any derived computation. The semantic audience fal
